$comment: Every public repository, its tier (repository.md, rule 1), and any check it is excused from. An exception is a reason string, or {"reason": "...", "until": "YYYY-MM-DD"} to be revisited by that date. An exception without a reason, one past its date, or one whose check now passes is reported.

exceptions.rulesets.no-classic-protection: The release workflow is being reworked; rulesets replace classic protection once it lands.
exceptions.rulesets.release-tags-locked: As above; the reworked release must still be able to create v* and eslint-plugin-v* tags.

exceptions.rulesets.main-pr-required: Not yet published to npm; becomes PR-only with its first release.
Light ruleset until the release rework (the current release pushes a bundled-action commit).
exceptions.rulesets.release-tags-locked: The current release force-moves its v* tag onto the commit with the bundled action; locked once the release is reworked.

exceptions.workflows.frozen-installs: ecosystem-probe.yml deliberately installs current releases the way a consumer would, on a schedule, with a read-only token and no secrets; a lockfile would defeat its purpose.

exceptions.workflows.main-green: The Deploy workflow fails by design: glaze-demo is a demo repository for GitHub Pulse, and the failing deploy is part of what it demonstrates.

exceptions.files.dependabot: Dependabot covers GitHub Actions only by design: the README names the exact TypeScript versions each trick is verified against, so those must not move automatically.
